ask: Summarise Help in three lines

Here is the Help in three lines:

1. Your records stay on your device, in the browser. Nothing leaves unless you turn on encrypted sync, and Health syncs only after its own opt-in.
2. Goals, habits, Health and Wealth work from your own records. Wealth totals are per currency and never converted. ZIGi, your own AI, proposes cards that you confirm, and it can never move money or delete anything.
